# paddle_discount_group (Data Source)

Look up an existing Paddle discount group by ID — see https://developer.paddle.com/api-reference/discount-groups/overview.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "paddle_discount_group" "example" {
  id = "dsg_01h8xd4x1r5jz1y9xzq1dqk6mt"
}

output "discount_group_name" {
  value = data.paddle_discount_group.example.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Paddle discount group ID (`dsg_...`) to look up.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String)
- `status` (String)
